collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - VILLAGE MOMENTS (VFX-01..12, draft for the owner, 2026-11-18)
Songs, chants and speeches, a long lazy afternoon, rain on the way, a roof patched with cloth: small moments where the whole village does something together, and the island answers.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: The sea leaves treasures on the shore: send everyone looking, or leave them for later.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After a night of strange, glittering waves, (name1) walks the shore at dawn and sees that the sea has left things lying everywhere: shells, odd stones, and small treasures half buried in the sand.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The whole village fans out along the shore. Here and there, something new is waiting to be found.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) decides the treasures will keep. By the time anyone goes looking, the tide has taken most of them back.
